panel.title: Ask Diogenes
panel.description: Choose a prepared question. Diogenes will answer with scripted guidance for this platform.
panel.typingLabel: Diogenes is preparing a scripted answer

persona.name: Diogenes
persona.greeting: Welcome. I can point you around the platform with a few prepared questions.
persona.description: I use scripted answers, so every response is predictable and safe for this class project.

platformOrientation.label: How do I use this platform?
platformOrientation.userMessage: How do I use this platform?
platformOrientation.response: Start with Learning Tracks to choose a small study path. Open a topic, read the explanation, try the practice prompt, and use accessibility help whenever you need display or language controls.

learningTracks.label: What are learning tracks?
learningTracks.response: Learning tracks group related topics into a clear route. Pick the track that matches your current goal, then use the path builder if you want a smaller custom sequence.

topicStudy.label: How should I study a topic?
topicStudy.userMessage: How should I study a topic?
topicStudy.response: Read the main explanation first, then pause at the professor note and practice prompt. Treat each topic as a small study session: understand, try, and then move to the next step.

progressFeedback.label: Where is my progress?
progressFeedback.response: Your saved paths and completed topics appear in the student area. Use the builder to save a path, then return to history when you want to resume or review progress.

accessibilityLanguage.label: How do accessibility and language work?
accessibilityLanguage.userMessage: How do accessibility and language work?
accessibilityLanguage.response: Use the header controls to switch language, light or dark theme, and high contrast. The accessibility help page explains these controls and why they support different study needs.
